title: Windows UI audit failed / overly brittle exact multiline comparisons
symptom: Windows job 128496997014 fails 11 string comparisons; Ubuntu passed. Line endings are a likely explanation, not proven sole cause.
fix: Normalize CRLF to LF before exact matching; then replace string tests with compilable view model and keyboard/focus integration tests; rerun on both platforms.
acceptance: Windows and Ubuntu checks green; each focus contract validated behaviorally.

title: Versioned Windows app launcher copies only EXE
symptom: Start Menu target is a top-level EXE copied away from adjacent published DLLs/runtime dependencies.
fix: Point shortcut directly to current\ServerRock.Native.exe in full versioned folder; remove stale shim carefully; update rollback/install and test from pristine profile.
acceptance: Install/launch/upgrade/rollback/uninstall on clean Win11 works without dotnet preinstalled.

title: Selected change commit may include unrelated staged changes
symptom: CommitSelectedCoreAsync stages selected paths then git commit -m, which commits entire pre-existing index.
fix: Prefer temporary GIT_INDEX_FILE copied from HEAD tree and stage only reviewed content, or reject nonempty unrelated index; ensure selected paths and hunks are exact; guard against concurrent workspace modifications.
acceptance: Given pre-staged unselected file, generated commit contains only selected files/hunks; existing index untouched.

title: No execution sandbox for approved workspace commands
symptom: Approved shell runs at user account privilege, outside workspace scope and with network access.
fix: Implement capability gate and managed isolated runner (separate process, restricted identity/container where available), explicit filesystem mounts and egress policy, strict timeout/output limits; preserve manual approval and explain residual controls.
acceptance: Test traversal, symlinks, network, secret access, child process tree, cancellation, permission prompts.

title: Prevent unsafe execution of imported skill scripts
symptom: Future GitHub skill downloads would introduce untrusted instructions/scripts without executable permission architecture.
fix: Add repo/commit pinning, manifest validation, checksums, path/symlink confinement, provenance, publisher warning, scoped caps, dry-run, explicit update diffs and rollback.
acceptance: Malicious manifest traversal/scripts/links cannot execute without scoped approval.

title: Coding Agent is one-shot XML-text proposal flow
symptom: No typed tool-call result loop or persisted goal execution.
fix: Build AgentRuntime: plan, typed tool registry, executor, observation, verifier, retries, checkpoint, cancellation, audit event stream; keep human approvals for privileged operations.
acceptance: Agent implements a fixture feature, compiles/tests it, reports diff and evidence across restart.

title: Project excerpts are bounded static sampling
symptom: Agent receives a small bounded file set and cannot selectively navigate large repos.
fix: Implement inventory, text search, symbol/AST indexing, chunk retrieval, on-demand bounded read; keep permissioned folders.
acceptance: Large 2k-file repo task finds correct files without full prompt upload; cites paths.

title: MainPage partial class holds most mutable UI/controller state
symptom: Cross-feature mutable fields complicate navigation state, dialogs and concurrency.
fix: Extract ChatSessionVM, WorkspaceVM, ModelLibraryVM, NavigationCoordinator, DialogService, TaskVM, provider interfaces; use DI and async commands.
acceptance: New VM tests independent of Uno; no state leakage after mode switching.

title: Overlay layering and hit-testing are not centrally owned
symptom: Sidebar drawer scrim/companion overlay share root and use ad-hoc z-index; potential covered controls, click-through or focus conflicts.
fix: Single OverlayHost with explicit ordered layers, scrim hit-test, dismiss policies, focus trap/return, lifecycle cancellation, safe areas; make companion noninteractive outside sprite area.
acceptance: Screenshots and hit tests at 560/768/1024/1280/1920 widths; no click-through/covered controls.

title: Large tools such as model library are ContentDialog rather than page
symptom: Long tools confined to modal height and oversized content; dialogs can hide workspace and cause nested-dialog conflicts.
fix: Create routed full-page Settings/Models/Skills/Tasks/Images; reserve dialogs for confirmations, short selectors, critical approvals.
acceptance: Every screen reachable without nested modal; search/list/detail panels resizable and keyboard accessible.

title: Dynamic status banner may obscure composer or vanish unexpectedly
symptom: RuntimeStatus 7-second timer dismisses messages using substring classification; some important failures may disappear.
fix: Replace with durable NotificationCenter storing severity, actions, persistent error IDs; separate ephemeral toasts.
acceptance: Failures remain discoverable; toasts do not cover composer; accessible announcements.

title: Companion positioning may obscure active page
symptom: Companion uses root overlay and manual offsets, and is moved near header in compact navigation.
fix: Default docked companion in designated side/status zone, optional drag floating with avoidance zones; overlay hit-test confined to sprite and dismiss on modal.
acceptance: No overlay intercepts conversation scroll, buttons, dialogs or composer at any breakpoint.

title: SkillCatalogService contains only prompt templates
symptom: Three hardcoded read-only skills; pressing Use skill only copies text into composer.
fix: Add SKILL.md registry, install/update/remove, tool requirements, model selection and invocation; searchable Marketplace UI with developer origin.
acceptance: Install one GitHub skill on Windows/Linux, use via agent, show update and rollback.

title: Plugin catalog shows unavailable integrations
symptom: Static directory displays unavailable integrations without runtime adapters.
fix: Build signed connector manifest, scoped auth, runtime health, auth lifecycle, uninstall; hide/nonfunctional actions clearly.
acceptance: Built-in works end-to-end; unavailable labelled clearly; revocation removes capability.

title: Scheduled tasks placeholder only
symptom: Button opens informational dialog, no persistent scheduler.
fix: Persistent job store, OS session process host, trigger and timezone, backoff, run history, pause/resume, permission review.
acceptance: Task scheduled, restarts app, runs once, logs outcome and avoids duplicates.

title: Only a selected model; no tested smart router
symptom: Requests use a configured endpoint/model; no task-dependent routing or concurrent agent model isolation.
fix: Provider adapters, capability inventory, tool-call compatibility, privacy tiers, fallback strategy, budgets; isolate model choice by session.
acceptance: Simulated provider outage triggers eligible fallback, not silent data transfer; concurrent local/cloud sessions.

title: Cloud credential lifecycle limited
symptom: OpenRouter key held session-only; not a unified provider credential system.
fix: Cross-platform OS vault or encrypted store with explicit provider scopes, rotation, revocation, no secrets in logs.
acceptance: Credential reconnect, expiry and removal on both platforms; no leakage.

title: Native update indicator not backed by secure update client
symptom: Update banner gated by environment variable; no evidenced native signed manifest consumer and update transaction.
fix: Implement version/channel manifest fetch, cryptographic verify, monotonic version, staged package, safe apply, restart+rollback, audit UI.
acceptance: Tampered manifest/package rejected; valid signed upgrade and rollback on Windows/Linux.

title: No published releases / main branch unprotected
symptom: Current API: zero Releases and protected=false for main.
fix: Configure required reviews/checks, pinned actions, least privilege, dependency scan, signing secrets; publish when green.
acceptance: Can no longer merge failed checks; signed artifacts verified by clean machine.

title: Workspace edit check/write is not one atomic transaction
symptom: Hash comparison and replacement not guaranteed exclusive against concurrent editors.
fix: Transaction lock per workspace path; temp write with flush; recheck identity under lock; atomic replace; journal and conflict display.
acceptance: Race harness never silently overwrites unrelated concurrent writes.

title: Git push preflight does not fetch current remote state
symptom: ahead/behind status describes local tracking data, which may be stale.
fix: Fetch remote with permission and timeout, verify fast-forward and protected target; maintain review and explicit push.
acceptance: Remote update between local status and push is handled without forced overwrite.

title: Model download preflight/resume/integrity varied by runtime
symptom: ModelScope SHA256 exists, other paths defer to runtime; disk/memory budget not consistently surfaced.
fix: Preflight sizes/space/VRAM/backend/license, progress journal, resume capability and checksum verification where source provides it.
acceptance: Failed/canceled download recovers cleanly; no disk exhaustion surprise.

title: Backend selection can silently alter model
symptom: When selected model absent, app chooses models[0] and saves settings.
fix: Show reconnection warning and ask to choose new default; preserve requested model in pending state.
acceptance: Missing pinned model does not silently switch local to cloud.

title: Settings changes can be lost due to dialog save/validation lifecycle
symptom: Settings validates only after dialog closes; model errors can leave users with no correction flow.
fix: Validate inline with settings draft VM before Save enabled; commit complete immutable settings snapshot only on valid submit; cancel discards draft.
acceptance: Invalid endpoint never closes screen; cancel never changes saved setting.

title: Navigation may disrupt editor or active context
symptom: Mode switch resets conversation and clears attachments after save; separate state exists for temporary chat and editing.
fix: Routed navigation with unsaved-work guards and per-workspace drafts, task-preserving mode transitions, back/forward and restore focus.
acceptance: Typing draft, switching page and returning retains draft and selected model/skill.

title: Runtime policy conflates tool eligibility with user intent
symptom: No immutable turn capability contract for tools, side effects and prompt context.
fix: Introduce typed CapabilityIntent, OfferedTools, AuthorizedTools, exact-action approval; planner may only narrow tool access.
acceptance: Tool prompt injection cannot expand filesystem/network grant.

title: Approval and operation history not durable enough for goal resume
symptom: Undo records exist but multi-file transactional goals and cross-restart step ledger do not.
fix: SQLite/WAL state store with execution ids, tool event log, approval grants, idempotency keys, checkpoints and resume coordinator.
acceptance: Crash between write and verification recovers with accurate status.

title: Streaming response updates render every chunk
symptom: Each callback sets whole TextBlock and scrolls; can stutter/auto-scroll away from user reading position.
fix: Batch UI updates 30-60Hz, virtualized messages, avoid autoscroll if user scrolled up, preserve copy/select.
acceptance: Long 50k-token stream stays responsive and does not move user scroll unexpectedly.

title: Model speed estimate uses character count / 4
symptom: Estimated tok/s is approximate and can misrank models.
fix: Prefer usage token counters; label estimates distinctly; account for warmup, TTFT, percentiles, failure rate.
acceptance: Model ranking based on reproducible benchmarks and confidence intervals.

title: Conversations and workspace undo are plaintext local files
symptom: Local data includes user conversation and previous content; no optional at-rest encryption.
fix: Offer encryption option, migration backup, secure backup/restore, selective retention and data inspection.
acceptance: Optional encrypted store recoverable with documented key strategy; export explicit.

title: Voice input on Windows only
symptom: Linux reports unavailable; speech uses OS API.
fix: Add optional cross-platform STT/TTS adapter with permissioned device access and supported local runtime; keep OS APIs where reliable.
acceptance: Windows/Linux input/output feature probes and graceful fallback.

title: Image Studio is narrow workflow dialog
symptom: User supplies workflow JSON and waits polling; no comprehensive workflow/model dependency manager.
fix: Full Images workspace, workflow gallery, node compatibility scan, queue, cancel/retry, result history; per-prompt correlation.
acceptance: Images render, manage queue and restore after navigation.

title: Existing UI contract audit checks source spelling, not behavior
symptom: Exact snippets can fail on innocuous refactors while a real focus bug passes.
fix: Use accessibility tree, keyboard traversals, visible focus, screen reader live regions, contrast checks, overflow screenshots.
acceptance: Test actual focus movement after modal close, drawer dismissal and errors.

title: Unhandled UI exception marked handled
symptom: App-wide UnhandledException sets Handled=true without guaranteed healthy state.
fix: Categorize recoverable exceptions; critical UI fault boundary with crash recovery, safe restart and diagnostics; never continue corrupted state.
acceptance: Injected unrecoverable fault gives safe recovery, not hidden broken UI.

title: Health scan provides heuristics, not full code audit
symptom: Local scan samples up to 2k files; Code Review Agent merely pre-fills prompt, cannot fetch GitHub itself.
fix: Add source acquisition, indexed analysis, dependency/vulnerability scan, test ingestion and evidence-backed report generation.
acceptance: Reviewer accepts folder/zip/repo, shows analyzed coverage, findings and source lines.

title: Too many primary actions represented as dialogs
symptom: Skills, models, status, scheduled tasks and plugins are dialog-first, minimizing search and state persistence.
fix: Design routed full pages with stable sidebar, deep links, details panels and progress sections; modal only for decisions.
acceptance: Search/list/detail remains operable at 1366x768 and 1920x1080.

title: Theme uses mixed hardcoded colors and tokens
symptom: Numerous literal hex colors produce inconsistent theme support.
fix: Central tokens for semantic colors, typography, spacing, radii, elevation, density, focus; dark/light and high contrast.
acceptance: Snapshot tests for themes; no text contrast or clipped dialogs.

title: No MCP agent integration found in native source
symptom: Native catalog declares future connectors; no native protocol-based tool registry established.
fix: MCP client adapters with schema validation, transport isolation, client/server auth and capability policy.
acceptance: Connect a test MCP server and invoke read-only tool; denied write cannot execute.

title: Core tests run sequential standalone harness
symptom: Tests stop on first failed check and UI behavior coverage limited.
fix: Adopt test framework with discovery, isolation, parallel-safe fixture, JUnit/TRX, coverage, native UI automation and benchmark CI.
acceptance: CI surfaces all failures with reports per OS, no hidden skips.

title: README may promise features beyond native implementation
symptom: Legacy/aspirational architecture and actual native feature set differ.
fix: Publish IMPLEMENTED/PARTIAL/PLANNED feature matrix updated in CI; eliminate misleading feature labels.
acceptance: Fresh install claims correspond to reproducible acceptance tests.
